Peer Assessment Rubric

Evaluate your peers across three dimensions (10 points total):

  • Git Workflow & Graph Integrity (4 pts): The submission exhibits a clean Git DAG showing separate witness branches, substantive commit messages, and a correctly resolved merge commit without leftover conflict markers (<<<<<<<).
  • Unicode Normalization & Philological Rigor (3 pts): The student demonstrates clear understanding of NFC vs. NFD normalization and identifies why diacritical decomposition causes silent collation failures.
  • Critical Reflection (3 pts): The reflection articulates how version control systems function as scholarly apparatuses, connecting computational tools directly to historical editorial theory.
